sentences.text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitut  seeking for the issuance of Writ of Mandamus, to direct the  respondents to initiate the Land Acquisition Proceedings under the  Right to fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, by taking into account of  petitioner's representation dated 18.12.2015, as the Land Acquisiti  proceedings Notification dated 29.04.2013 in Na.Ka.No.NH.49/Unit-  V/7/2011 issued under Section 3D, 3G(3) of the National Highways  Act (48/1956) deemed to be lapsed.
 For Petitioners : No appearance  For R1 to R3 :

Mr.A.Kannan,
 Additional Government Pleade  For R4 : No appearance
ORDER When the matter was taken up for hearing on 13.02.2023, there was no representation for the petitioners.
Therefore, the matter was directed to be listed today under the caption For Dismissal.
Even https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis today, there is no representation for the petitioners.

Hence,
the writ petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
